top_issues: Home desktop: the legend under $11,500.00 (On-chain $0.00 / Reserve $1,500.00 / Accounts $10,000.00) repeats the stacked bar and the Instant line; it adds chip-like color keys and hurts premium quietness.

Home desktop: USDC row bar is a short green+indigo strip while Hub One’s send/receive bar is ~60k+40k wide; 1 px = $50 is stated but the home total bar is not at that absolute width, so visceral scale breaks across the same screen.
Home desktop: Pay is a filled indigo slab next to outlined Receive/Swap; three equal-width CTAs compete with the total and make the left column feel like a toolbar, not a ledger.
fixes: Home: delete the three-swatch legend; put On-chain / Reserve / Accounts only in the bar itself or a hover caption.
Home: draw the total bar and the USDC bar on the same 1px=$50 scale as Hub One (or fade overflow), never compress the $11.5k bar to ~1/8 of the account bar.
Home: keep one primary Pay; demote Receive/Swap to text or icon-only under the total.

top_issues: Pay desktop: Amount is the huge “25” but the card also shows This payment 25.00, Your account with Hub One 10,000.00, send/receive caps, and a duplicate Hub One bar in the right column — three copies of the same bilateral bar.
Pay desktop: To card dumps the full 0x499d0dc… address in a wrapping mono line under Meridian Desk; it fights the amount and looks like a block explorer, not a wallet.
Pay desktop: Fee 0.000050 USDC vs “fee 0.000025 of 0.000050 total” in Route is hard to parse at a glance; two fee stories on one screen.
fixes: Pay: keep the bilateral bar only in YOUR ACCOUNT WITH HUB ONE; in the amount card show a thin preview of the $25 debit on the same scale, not a second full 100k-wide bar.
Pay: truncate To to Meridian Desk + 0x499d…ef2bd; copy-on-click, no wrap.
Pay: one fee line: “Fee 0.000050 USDC · Hub One 0.000025”; drop the Route fee sentence.

top_issues: Receipt desktop: no value bar at all — $25 vs remaining $9,975 is not viscerally comparable to Home/Pay.
Receipt desktop: Settled shows 00:43:08 in 2038 ms; clock time and latency share a row so neither reads as “instant proof”.
Receipt desktop: modal sits over a still-interactive-looking Home; dim is weak and the X vs Done double-dismiss is noisy.
fixes: Receipt: add a 1px=$50 debit tick (25px) on the Hub One bar, matching Pay’s After state.
Receipt: split rows — Settled 00:43:08 and Latency 2.038s — mint only on latency.
Receipt: stronger scrim; keep Done, drop X, or make X the only close.

top_issues: Receive desktop: QR dominates the left column while Amount is 0.00 and the request is empty; the eye lands on a code, not on what to collect.
Receive desktop: the amount bar is a full-width indigo fade with no notch/zero and no 1px=$50 mapping to the 40,025 receive cap — looks decorative.
Receive desktop: SHARE card stacks Copy invoice, Copy link, and Copy xln:// app link; three copy actions plus a long Entity ID dump.
fixes: Receive: put Amount + note above a smaller QR; QR secondary until amount > 0.
Receive: draw inbound capacity as the right half of the same Hub One bar (notch at 0), preview the requested amount on that scale.
Receive: one primary Copy link; invoice/xln:// as overflow. Truncate Entity ID to 0xf581…476b.

top_issues: Swap desktop: You receive 0.00 WETH with a disabled lavender Swap CTA while You pay 100 USDC — the primary action is inert and the quote is missing, so the screen feels unfinished.
Swap desktop: left column is a narrow mobile stack; right column is a short Hub One bar then a desert of empty canvas — desktop width unused.
Swap desktop: Same network / Across networks pills float top-right, disconnected from the form; sandbox chip on USDC adds noise.
fixes: Swap: never show a primary Swap until You receive has a live quote; use a quiet “Waiting for Hub One quote” instead of a faded button.
Swap: two-column: form left, book/account+quote right filling the rail height.
Swap: put network mode inside the form header; drop sandbox chip from the token control.

top_issues: Account desktop: four-color legend (collateral / credit line / owed / in flight) sits above the USDC card and repeats what the bar already encodes; purple in-flight is unused here.
Account desktop: Pay / Extend credit / Swap again as three equal buttons under the title — same CTA pattern as Home, crowding Hub One identity.
Account desktop: THIS ACCOUNT table (Counterparty Hub, Network sandbox, Frames 7) is sparse against a large empty lower-right; desktop unused.
fixes: Account: remove the floating legend; caption the bar with owed | credit | collateral only if a segment is non-zero.
Account: one Pay in the header; Extend credit as a row action next to Your credit line to them.
Account: pin THIS ACCOUNT under the bar in one column or fill the right with recent frames for this account.

top_issues: Activity desktop: list and inspector have no money bars; −25 vs +10,000 cannot be compared viscerally to Home/Account.
Activity desktop: All/Payments/Swaps/Settlement/Accounts chip row plus 4 movements is light chrome for four rows; Settlement/Swaps empty-state not shown.
Activity desktop and 08-activity-detail.png: the two captures are the same frame — selected Sent row + inspector — so “detail” does not increase density or proof.
fixes: Activity: 1px=$50 hairline beside each amount (25px vs 200px for 10k) so magnitudes match Home.
Activity: default to All without five chips until a type has >0; show empty copy inside filters.
Activity detail: inspector should expand proof (full hash, frame diff, counterparties), not clone 07.

top_issues: Activity detail desktop: identical to 07-activity.png — no extra hierarchy for the selected payment.
Activity detail: Proof 0x74ac131b…ed3643 and Frames 5 committed entries are low-contrast and truncated; trust cue is present but not inspectable.
Activity detail: To packs Meridian Desk 0x499d0d…f2bd on one cramped right edge — collision of name and address.
fixes: Activity detail: full-height inspector — amount, 1px=$50 bar, then copyable proof and frame list.
Activity detail: wrap To as name stacked over truncated address, not inline.
Activity detail: mint “From your runtime’s committed frames” is enough; drop the duplicate SETTLED chip in the card header if the list already shows settled.

top_issues: Settings desktop: 1 px = $50 is shown three times (header, beside slider, Auto label) — redundant for a premium settings page.
Settings desktop: AT THIS SCALE $100 = 2 px is a 2px speck that fails data_legibility; the pedagogical chart undermines the scale it teaches.
Settings desktop: Reveal recovery phrase and Lock are equal ghost buttons at the bottom; recovery is higher-risk than lock.
fixes: Settings: one 1 px = $50 readout, tied to the slider thumb.
Settings: start the legend at $1,000 or $5,000 so the smallest bar is ≥8px, or label sub-pixel amounts as text only.
Settings: Lock as quiet text; Reveal recovery phrase as a single destructive/secondary control with confirm.

overall.verdict: Light desktop is a competent two-column fintech shell with real proof cues (frames, runtime verify, bilateral bars), but it is not yet premium: Home/Pay repeat numbers and legends, Swap is an empty quote, and Activity abandons the one-scale bar. Light theme contrast is mostly fine, yet indigo CTAs, chips, and outlined cards add noise that Revolut/Cash App would delete.
priority_fixes: Enforce one absolute bar scale on Home total, Home USDC, Account, Pay, Receive, and Activity amounts; fade overflow instead of compressing $11.5k next to a 100k credit bar.
Kill repeating chrome: Home tier legend, Pay duplicate Hub One bars, Account color legend, Settings’ triple 1px=$50, five Activity chips.
One primary CTA per screen (Pay); demote Receive/Swap/Extend credit so desktop does not look like three equal app-store buttons.
Finish Swap: live You receive quote and a non-disabled primary, and fill the right column instead of leaving half the canvas blank.
Make receipts/activity inspectable: latency vs timestamp split, copyable proof, and a 25px debit mark so $25 is viscerally small against $10k.
